title: Siege of Tripolitsa
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Tripolitsa", at revision 1380606574, opens: "The siege of Tripolitsa or fall of Tripolitsa, also known as the Tripolitsa massacre, was an early victory of the revolutionary Greek forces in the summer of 1821 during the Greek War of Independence, which had begun earlier that year, against the Ottoman Empire. Tripolitsa was an important target, because it was the administrative center of the Ottomans in the Peloponnese." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2590023, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1821 siege and massacre of Muslims and Jews in Tripolitsa". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
